The '''Duros''' (occasionally '''Durosians'''<ref name="coj">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>) were a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]]<ref name="SoF" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] who were among [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] first [[Realspace/Legends|space]] faring civilizations.<ref name="TEA" />

Their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was located on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], a major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that linked Duro with other important commercial centers.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Duros.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Ohwun De Maal/Legends|Ohwun De Maal]] and [[Chachi De Maal/Legends|Chachi De Maal]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].]]
The Duros {{Pronounced|Dǒǒ'-rōs}}<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> were humanoids with smooth blue-green skin, red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], lipless [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]], long thin noseless faces and green [[Blood/Legends|blood]].<ref name="CotF">{{TCW|Children of the Force}} preview at Cartoon Network</ref> Olfactory organs beneath their eyes were responsible for their sense of smell. Both females and males were bald, though both sexes were easily distinguished. Their large red goggle-like eyes also had slit pupils. Duros females laid eggs as they were descended from ancient reptiles, and like the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]], they were born in a larval grub stage, but unlike their cousins who left the raising of their young mainly to the state, the Duros took care of their offspring from birth.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

==Society==
While usually taciturn, Duros enjoyed telling stories about their travels. It was said Duros had a photographic memory when it came to the telling of tales and stories.<ref name="The Paradise Snare">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> Many Duros were [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and explorers, and were adventurous, though sometimes rash. As one of the first cultures to develop [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Realspace/Legends|spacecraft]] (some even believe the first), Duros-charted trade routes were among the oldest [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes still in use during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] era. Even in the later periods of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, Duros were still known for their superior astro-navigational skills. Their affinity for traveling led many Duros to prefer the honorific title of "Traveler" despite their occupation or craft of choice, and addressing them as such was considered good etiquette.<ref name="The Paradise Snare" /> The Duros language was [[Durese/Legends|Durese]], which was a lingua franca of sorts amongst [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

[[File:Duros_Archaeologist_EtU.png|thumb|left|200px|Levet, a Duros archaeologist]]
The Duros also established a vast, grand [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction industry in the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]] that rivaled the one in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. The Duros set up their government around a consortium of starship construction corporations, with all important [[Politics/Legends|political]] decisions made by the stockholders of the corporations. This meant that any Duros that held stock in a company could participate in the administration of the system.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />

The Duros were also one of the founding races of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Years before the formation of the Republic, the Duros colonized the planet [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]], giving rise to a genetically distinct "newer version" of Duros, the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]]. The Neimoidians retained many similarities to their Duros cousins including basic form, noseless faces, and green skin (though Neimoidians tended to be grayer). However, in contrast to their ancestors, Neimoidians possessed pupils that split horizontally, lumpy foreheads, and perpetually frowning mouths. In addition, Neimoidians tended to be cowardly, greedy and fearful of death, whereas the average Duro was adventurous, gregarious and peaceful. Not surprisingly, one of the most powerful insults among the Duros was to be called a Neimoidian.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> By the time of the rise of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], however, the Duros were friendlier towards the Neimoidians, and respected their business skills.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

After a young Duros was born, they were cared for and raised by their family members. This was another thing that set them apart from the Neimoidians, who did not really care for their young actively.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

The [[Duros lending tradition]] was followed by the Duros when asking for loans to Duros lending institutions. Failing to comply with its terms supposed a severe social stigma for them.<ref name="ss">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Cad_Bane_cover.png|thumb|right|180px|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], a notorious Duros bounty hunter during the Clone Wars]]
{{Quote|We have a proud and rich history with many archaeological monuments and treasures from Duro's Golden Age. Nearly every schoolchild on every civilized planet learns about our ancient history&mdash;that glorious time when my people were ruled by the great Queen Rana, our wise lawgiver.|[[Dustini Spa Ronii]]|<ref name="Mission from Mount Yoda">''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]''</ref>}}
The Duros originated on the planet Duro long before the dawn of the Galactic Republic. In [[100,000 BBY/Legends|100,000 BBY]], Duro was surveyed by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]], who were not impressed. Later, Duro was conquered by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] and the native Duros were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]. Duros slaves were used to create the [[Star Forge]] in [[30,000 BBY]]. However, they tolerated their cruel overlords, since it was an occasion for the ever-curious Duros to learn about their inter-stellar technology.<ref name="TEA" />

Following a plague in [[25,200 BBY]] that killed only Rakata, the Duros rebelled and overthrew their Rakatan masters. The Duros then formed a hereditary monarchy.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> After the fall of the Empire, they quickly reverse-engineered the engines left by the Rakata, and thus invented the [[hyperspace cannon]] independently of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]].

At an early age, the Duros became interested in exploration and ventured off their homeworld to explore the galaxy and their interstellar technology linked Duro with [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and other [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]; with the Corellians they built the first arm of the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and with the invention of the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], the planet entered a Golden Age as a [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founder]] in [[25,053 BBY]] under [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Rana Mas Trehalt]]. The Duros also constructed large shipyards and spacedocks in their planet's orbit. The monarchy was eventually abolished in favor of a collection of ruling corporations.

The Duros colonized Neimoidia during their earliest wave of expansion, though the Neimoidians were considered a separate culture by [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]. The Duros also discovered [[Sneeve/Legends|Sneeve]] in the [[Kymoodon Era]], [[Adner]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], and [[Koboth]] prior to [[219 BBY]].

In [[3962 BBY]], the planet itself was laid to near-total waste during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], when the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] invasion fleet advancing on the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and Core regions destroyed much of the world using thousands of [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]]. Years of misery and rebuilding were ahead of the Duros people, merely the latest phase in the long series of [[Old Sith Wars]]. In [[1003 BBY]], during the [[New Sith Wars]], the Duros colony on [[Harpori]] was wiped out by [[Kaox Krul]].

[[File:Brute_TotG.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Duros brute]]
In [[220 BBY/Legends|220 BBY]], during Duro's Industrial Age, the mining city of [[Tayana]] reached its height. In [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], the [[Tiercam Dam]] was built. The Duros also set up large food processing plants that polluted Duro's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], forcing the them to relocate to 20 orbiting cities throughout their home system.

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched [[Operation Durge's Lance]], a coordinated major campaign that led to the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|capture of Duro]]. The swift success of the campaign sent shockwaves throughout the Galactic Republic, and even neutral Corellia began to tighten its defenses.

After the Clone Wars, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] collected what was left of Duro's natural resources, and forced many Duros to move off the planet. In an attempt to stir up conflict between Duro and Corellia, the Empire declared Duro to be part of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the prisoner [[Triclops]] was moved to Duro by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa]]. However, Triclops escaped and saved his son [[Ken]] from Hissa. Although the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] managed to save Duros archaeologists from the [[Valley of Royalty]], the Valley itself was flooded with toxic waste when the Tiercam Dam burst.

The New Republic eventually liberated the planet, and put the system back in the Duro Sector. Ecosystem purification teams cleaned up the planet's atmosphere as best they could. In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], Duro was retaken by the Empire during [[Operation Shadow Hand]].<ref name="DEII">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]''</ref> However, it was eventually liberated by the New Republic.

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], [[CorDuro Shipping]] took control of the [[Pri-Andylan shipyards]].<ref name="MFR">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021003recovery|text=Making a Full ''Recovery''}}</ref> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tresina Lobi]] and [[Thrynni Vae]] discovered CorDuro Shipping's ties to the [[Peace Brigade]], resulting in the Brigade murdering Thrynni.<ref name="BP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>

In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the New Republic attempted to make Duro habitable and settle refugees there, though their efforts were sabotaged by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] agent [[Nom Anor]].<ref name="BP" /> The Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] Duro and managed to reverse centuries of pollution in just two years. Later, the planet was liberated by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and it is likely that the Duros returned to the now lush Duro after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war's]] end. 

By [[130 ABY]], unlike [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] old Empire, the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|New Empire]] actively recruited [[Alien/Legends|non-Humans]], tapping Duros spacefaring expertise to train its naval forces. At the Imperial Naval Academy on Duro, native specialists instructed recruits, significantly elevating fleet proficiency.<ref>[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide|''Legacy Era Campaign Guide'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]'', female Duros are depicted with long ponytails, despite other sources claiming both males and females are bald.
